issues.description: SAS code defines MY and DATASETS only; COMP and CRSP librefs, shared project paths, Stata working directory, and the analysis input location are not established by supplied setup files.

The archive contains code, documentation, the A.1–A.2 event tables and a gvkey identifier list, but not the prepared files consumed by the programs. Frozen catalog and same-run probes show local Compustat/CRSP/DealScan candidates; exact author-compatible history, derived datasets, exchange/NETS inputs, and public BEA/BLS output formats remain unresolved.

Main code invokes two absent do-files: HQ history corrections (author access is requested in source comment) and tax-change cleaning/mapping based on hand-collected Table A.1 data. Their exact transformations and producer outputs are unavailable in this package.

The supplied main script documents Table 2 output; appendix Tables A.3–A.12 include additional specifications and DealScan, SDC, CRSP, and Compustat analyses without matching supplied program/output mapping. Full target closure cannot be confirmed.

The existing SAS runtime probe failed during TKELS startup, which does not establish version, PROC EXPAND availability or licensing; Stata 18 is available, but the dedicated probe did not find the required outreg2 command.

actions.description: Resolve the exact analysis-ready inputs and configuration. Frozen metadata/probes show local raw Compustat and CRSP candidates, and local DealScan products for the appendix, but not compatible historical coverage or the author’s derived variables/files.
steps: For each code-consumed dataset, specify exact source version, selected fields, sample/year coverage, identifiers, transformation and file path; inspect the documented local Compustat/CRSP candidate fields against that contract.
Confirm or provide the exchange.sas7bdat, compustat_start, NETS weighted changes, and BEA/BLS outputs with their producer/conversion steps.
Confirm COMP/CRSP library assignments, Stata working directories, and cross-language file handoffs.
Record and apply the SAS library definitions and shared working-directory/path setup assumed by the supplied scripts before opening any dataset.
validation: After authorized setup, confirm each required input opens and contains the source fields and period needed by its downstream stage.

actions.description: Obtain the two invoked author do-files and their accompanying hand-collected HQ and tax-change inputs/specifications; the source explicitly directs readers to contact an author for the HQ corrections file.
steps: Request the exact HQ history-correction and tax-change cleaning programs, their inputs/outputs, and supported path/configuration assumptions.
Keep the manually collected state tax rates and loss-offset changes as the authors document them; do not reconstruct missing firm-year assignments independently.
validation: Review the returned files and confirm the named producers generate the variables/files consumed by LZZ_JAR_Code.do.

actions.description: Obtain the author program/output map and exact data specifications for Tables A.3–A.12, including DealScan A.5, SDC M&A A.9, and CRSP/Compustat appendix analyses; preserve all documented appendix analyses in target scope.
steps: Request the supplied appendix scripts, complete stage order, and per-table data requirements, filters, joins, and variable construction.
Identify required access or author-prepared files for each appendix dataset and record verified routes without substituting proxy measures.
validation: Confirm every documented appendix table has a supplied or author-specified reproducible script and all inputs are mapped before declaring workflow closure.

actions.description: Resolve the SAS startup/TKELS configuration and confirm PROC EXPAND; configure the invoked outreg2 command in the intended Stata 18 adopath.
steps: Resolve the SAS startup/TKELS environment configuration or confirm the intended supported SAS installation and PROC EXPAND availability.
Install or configure the exact outreg2 command in a Stata adopath if it is not available in the intended execution environment.
validation: Run software-only version/which checks in the intended environment before any authorized research execution.

review_notes: Expanded source and bounded metadata checkpoint saved before finalization.
